name: Demo False Trigger
description: Demo Policy whose condition is never satisfied. It blocks a Deliverable from moving from Defined to In Progress, so the Policy gate can be shown refusing a transition.

conditions.statement: The Deliverable meets a condition that is never satisfied before it moves from Defined to In Progress.

relatedObligations.title: Resolve the Demo False Trigger Policy
relatedObligations.description: The requirements analysis model may not start until the Demo False Trigger Policy is resolved. Its condition is never satisfied, so the Policy gate refuses the Defined to In Progress transition until this Obligation is closed.
relatedObligations.completionCriteria: The Policy gate has been shown refusing the transition and a manager has closed this Obligation.

requiredEvidence.title: Policy gate refusal shown
requiredEvidence.description: A record that the Policy gate refused the Defined to In Progress transition.
requiredEvidence.collectionMethod: Manual attestation recorded by the responsible Authority holder.
